paragraphs: Abba Chanan, in R. Elazar's name: Yevamot 64a, 95b; Bava Batra 119b, 120, 130a; Yoma 3b; Nazir 45a. In R. Eliezer's name, etc.; R. Shimon Shezuri says, etc. Sanhedrin 17a: in R. Eliezer's name. Yalkut, Mishpatim, quotes this Mekhilta with Abba Shaul in R. Elazar's name, a scribal error, since we have not found Abba Shaul speaking in R. Elazar's name. Bemidbar Rabbah, sections 9, 13; Mekhilta Mishpatim, sections 3, 8, and 12, in the commentary, folio 32, column 3. Sifrei, Naso, passage “Speak to the children of Israel,” and there, passage “The priest shall stand.” In R. Yehoshua's name: Niddah 29a. This indicates he was early. Yuchasin writes that Abba Chanan lived in Rav Nachman's time, without giving evidence. I think this arose from Sanhedrin 17a: “They prophesied in the camp”—what did they prophesy? Abba Chanan says in R. Eliezer's name: concerning the quail. Rav Nachman says: concerning Gog and Magog. It understood that he lived in Rav Nachman's generation. This is not so, for he was early: the R. Eliezer in whose name he spoke is ben Horkenos. Yuchasin, in Rav Sherira Gaon's name, says Abba Chanan lived in the generation of Chanan ben Pinchas, R. Yishmael son of R. Yochanan ben Beroka, and R. Yehoshua ben Korcha.
